The root-owned earlier dirty target at 5ac0d552ec873a487162d0021cb57ba1f4918f1629bb0c116bc40b46d1cca538 is known only by its recorded hash and metadata; its exact bytes or a dirty-preimage-to-candidate patch are unavailable. contract_and_property.original_runtime_property: Two concurrent Runtime control-worker jobs share the configured MethodBackend admission boundary across compute and blocking-I/O work; capacity one admits no more than one method fold at once, capacity two admits no more than two, all expected folds/results are retained and freshly read back, and removing the bridge exposes the expected admission escape.
contract_and_property.driver_property: The outer test attempts each of the three declared child profiles in its own fresh subprocess, retains complete child stdout/stderr before the aggregate decision, records typed failure outcomes for runner errors, timeouts, malformed markers, and nonzero exits, and fails unless the exact configured profile set all passes.
contract_and_property.native_child_workload_shape: The child uses two concurrent test-defined Scientist workflow jobs and TMLE MethodBackend execution, serial fold configuration, two repeats by three folds per study, and checks fold completeness, worker dispatch, owner scopes, terminal state, CAS artifacts, evidence links, and fresh result/evidence reads. This is a synthetic integration fixture, not an established production workload roster or production sizing input.
contract_and_property.instrumentation: The child observes shared executor queue residence and classifies submissions, records BlockingDependencyGuard context at control-store and CAS seams, and captures guarded put_json payloads at the canonical CAS operation. The two slowest eligible payloads may be retained per child within a 25 MiB total child-payload budget; oversize payloads retain size/hash/reference metadata only.
contract_and_property.semantic_effect: This commit widens the diagnostic runner to attempt all three declared profiles before aggregation. It does not itself exercise or establish the Runtime property because the three native children remain UNRUN.

P38_property_vs_implementation.property: The shared runtime admission invariant and its removal falsifier hold over the complete declared profile set.
P38_property_vs_implementation.implementation: The parent driver attempts the three declared child scenarios and aggregates their structured statuses; native child assertions measure queue, guard, folds, CAS, ownership, and readback behavior.
P38_property_vs_implementation.divergence: A passing parent driver or successful subprocess exit is not the Runtime property. The native child results and their actual measurements are currently UNRUN; driver coverage cannot be promoted to runtime evidence.
